title: Concept: Dependency declared with a v-prefixed version
description: package.json declares a version written with a `v` prefix, which is a tag name rather than a semantic version, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: npm resolves the text as a dist-tag or rejects it, so the install depends on what the registry happens to have tagged rather than on the version the review saw.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: npm resolves the text as a dist-tag or rejects it, so the install depends on what the registry happens to have tagged rather than on the version the review saw.
